  <title>Red Line Reaches 50 MPH Between North Quincy and JFK/UMass</title>
  <link>https://www.mbta.com/news/2026-10-30/red-line-reaches-50-mph-between-north-quincy-and-jfkumass</link>
  <description>The MBTA announces today that another section of the Red Line, North Quincy to JFK/UMass, can accommodate trains traveling up to 50 MPH.</description>
  <pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:44:59 -0400</pubDate>

<item>
  <title>MBTA to Host Two Community Meetings for Regional Rail Modernization in November </title>
  <link>https://www.mbta.com/news/2026-10-28/mbta-host-two-community-meetings-regional-rail-modernization-november</link>

<item>
  <title>MBTA Extends Four Ferry Routes Through the End of the Year </title>
  <link>https://www.mbta.com/news/2026-10-28/mbta-extends-four-ferry-routes-through-the-end-the-year</link>
  <description>The MBTA announces today that service for select ferry routes will extend to December 31, 2026: East Boston, Lynn, Winthrop, Quincy.</description>

<item>
  <title>MBTA, Animal Rescue League of Boston to Transform Park Street into “Bark Street” on October 29</title>
  <link>https://www.mbta.com/news/2026-10-26/mbta-animal-rescue-league-boston-transform-park-street-bark-street-october-29</link>
  <description>In support of October as Adopt a Shelter Dog Month, the MBTA in partnership with the Animal Rescue League of Boston are transforming Park Street Station into “Bark Street Station” on October 29, 4 - 6 PM, for an afternoon of four-legged fun.</description>
  <pubDate>Mon, 26 Oct 2026 10:28:07 -0400</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>MBTA Media Relations</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="false">8051</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>MBTA Releases New Round of Collectable CharlieCards Celebrating Boston  </title>
  <link>https://www.mbta.com/news/2026-10-20/mbta-releases-new-round-collectable-charliecards-celebrating-boston</link>
  <description>The MBTA today shared it has released five new special edition collectable CharlieCards featuring iconic Boston landmarks including: the Massachusetts State Capital building, Bunker Hill Monument, the Boston Tea Party Ship &amp; Museum, and TD Garden.</description>
  <pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 06:23:07 -0400</pubDate>

<item>
  <title>MBTA Continues Modernizing and Investing to Improve Reliability, Accessibility, and More as Major Construction Advances</title>
  <link>https://www.mbta.com/news/2026-10-16/mbta-continues-modernizing-and-investing-improve-reliability-accessibility-and-more</link>
  <description>In November, the MBTA will accomplish work on critical Green Line central tunnel signal modernization, accessibility upgrades on the Green Line, important switch work near Wonderland, signal pre-commissioning on the Red Line, and Commuter Rail improvements while also supporting MassDOT work as part of the West Roxbury Parkway Bridge Replacement project.</description>
  <pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 12:19:04 -0400</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>MBTA Media Relations</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="false">8043</guid>
    </item>
